concerns.text: Task T012 explicitly states it 'uses MOCKED tool output' and 'does NOT satisfy FR-003 real execution'. FR-003 mandates real execution of SonarQube, DeepSource, and CodeClimate. Tagging a mock-based task as satisfying FR-003 is a semantic weakening of the functional requirement.

Tasks T018 (edge case handling) and T019 (saving raw reports with checksums) are marked as unchecked/missing. T027 (alignment) and T032 (metrics) depend on the output of T019. Without T019, the pipeline cannot generate the 'raw JSON reports' required by FR-003 and the 'ground truth' inputs for FR-005/FR-006. This drops critical acceptance criteria for data integrity and pipeline completion.

Task T023 (generating heuristic candidates) is unchecked. T023b and T028 (Union Ground Truth) depend on T023's output. FR-004 requires parsing comments to extract annotations and establishing ground truth. Without T023, the 'heuristic candidates' stream of the ground truth is missing, violating the dual-source ground truth construction mandated by the plan and spec.

Task T024a (Random Stream sampling) is unchecked. T024b depends on it. The Plan and Spec require a 'stratified random sample' independent of keywords to avoid bias. T024b describes ingesting a file that is never generated by a preceding task. This drops the acceptance criterion for the 'Random Stream' component of the ground truth, violating FR-004 and SC-005.

Tasks T001b (config.yaml) and T002b (git/venv) are unchecked. T009 (env config) and T010 (checksum logic) depend on these foundational artifacts. While minor, the absence of these setup tasks creates a gap in the 'Data Hygiene' (Constitution Principle III) and 'Reproducibility' (Principle I) requirements, as the environment and configuration state are not explicitly established.
